subject: Supplier intake: ESG questionnaire & PO activation for Verdev Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Alvarez <lina@verdev.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier intake: ESG questionnaire & PO activation for Verdev Systems

Hi Lina,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — excited about the potential to include Verdev's edge adapter in our Dedicated offering. Procurement side: to move toward PO setup and first payment we need a few intake items from your team. Can you review the checklist below and send back items where available by EOD Friday (2026-08-14)? If any items need more time, flag which ones and an ETA.

Required items for supplier setup and compliance:
- Completed Redwood Supplier Intake Form (attached PDF) — basic company details, tax ID, bank wiring information.
- Signed W-9 (or equivalent) for tax purposes.
- ESG & Supplier Diversity questionnaire (attached spreadsheet) — key fields: emissions policy, diversity metrics, modern slavery statement, supplier code of conduct.
- Modern slavery / human trafficking policy doc (if published) or a short attestation.
- Copy of current ISO/SOC reports (if available) or SOC 2 in-progress note.

Optional but helpful:
- Sample invoice template for faster PO matching.
- Primary billing contact and preferred invoice delivery method (email, EDI).

Next steps once we receive documents:
1) Finance will validate tax/bank details and issue initial PO.
2) Legal will review any redlines on T&Cs (we'll surface these within 48h).
3) CS will schedule a kick-off integration call.

I've attached the Supplier Intake Form, ESG questionnaire template, and our W-9 to this message. Let me know if you prefer a DocuSign flow for the intake form.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable), ESG_Supplier_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), W9_Form.pdf

From: Lina Alvarez <lina@verdev.co>

Date: 2026-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier intake: ESG questionnaire & PO activation for Verdev Systems

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching the following in this reply: DUNS_and_tax_packet.pdf (contains tax ID and company registration), Verdev_Modern_Slavery_Policy.pdf, and our completed ESG_Responses.xlsx (filled into your template).

A couple of quick notes/questions:
1) Bank wiring — we prefer to send a voided check versus entering account numbers on forms. Is that acceptable for Redwood Finance?
2) SOC 2: we're in the middle of an audit (in fieldwork). I included a note in the ESG tab explaining timing; we expect a report by Q4.
3) Diversity metrics: our supplier diversity program is nascent — we track a small number of certified suppliers and have a vendor diversity goal for next year. I've added a short narrative under Q6.

If you need the intake form signed via DocuSign, we can accept that — otherwise I can return a scanned signature on the PDF.

-Lina
Head of Partnerships
Verdev Systems
Attachments: DUNS_and_tax_packet.pdf, Verdev_Modern_Slavery_Policy.pdf, ESG_Responses.xlsx

1) Bank verification: Redwood Finance prefers either a voided check or a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming routing/account; scanned voided check is fine for now. We'll process wiring on receipt and validate during payment.
2) For the intake form signature: DocuSign is preferred only for T&Cs; for intake metadata a scanned signature is fine.

Grace — FYI on the SOC 2 timeline note; please flag any terms we may need to pause on until the report is available.

Lina — can you confirm an ETA for the voided check/bank letter (end of week would be ideal) and whether you want us to start a preliminary PO (non-payment-holding) so you can begin resource onboarding? If yes, we'll issue a PO with a pending payment condition.

Thanks,
